name: Cobblestone Lissencephaly

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic cobblestone (type II) lissencephaly on brain imaging
Clinical features including congenital muscular dystrophy and ocular abnormalities
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with cobblestone lissencephaly (e.g., POMT1, POMT2, FKRP)
Developmental delay and hypotonia consistent with neuronal migration disorder

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic brain imaging findings plus clinical features of muscular dystrophy and ocular abnormalities
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical and imaging features are definitive.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Cobblestone lissencephaly pattern on brain MRI

searchTerms: low muscle tone with muscle disease

pathognomonic.symptomName: Ocular malformations including retinal dysplasia and optic nerve hypoplasia
searchTerms: eye abnormalities including retina and optic nerve problems
malformed retina and small optic nerve

common.symptomName: Feeding difficulties due to oromotor dysfunction
searchTerms: feeding issues due to weak oral muscles

common.symptomName: Respiratory insufficiency secondary to muscle weakness
searchTerms: respiratory failure due to muscle weakness

occasional.symptomName: Cleft palate or other craniofacial anomalies
searchTerms: split or opening in the roof of mouth
cystic kidney disease present at birth
hormone problems including low sex hormones
skin problems like dry, scaly skin

laboratory: Elevated creatine kinase levels indicating muscle damage
Abnormal electromyography consistent with muscular dystrophy
imaging: MRI showing cobblestone lissencephaly with irregular cortical surface
genetic: Pathogenic variants in POMT1, POMT2, FKRP, or related genes involved in glycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan
other: Muscle biopsy showing dystrophic changes and abnormal glycosylation

distinguishingFeatures: Smooth brain surface without cobblestone pattern
Absence of muscular dystrophy and ocular abnormalities
More severe brain malformations including hydrocephalus
Severe eye malformations and congenital muscular dystrophy

redFlags: Severe hypotonia with feeding and respiratory difficulties in neonate
Characteristic cobblestone pattern on brain MRI
Presence of congenital muscular dystrophy with ocular malformations
references: Dobyns WB, et al. Cobblestone lissencephaly: clinical and genetic aspects. Am J Med Genet C Semin Med Genet. 2010.
Godfrey C, et al. Refining genotype-phenotype correlations in muscular dystrophies with brain malformations. Brain. 2011.
